toolchains.compiler: GCC14.3 (pinned native cache/build flags in campaign)

notes: No relative competitor cap: cells used fixed whole-cell deadlines.
ParAC cells predate the current stopping rule (patch 0007) and report ParAC's own residual on its own right-hand side.
GPU apxchol series use degree quantile 0.8 or 0.2; the current device default is 0.5.
cap_rule: none relative to apxchol; cells used fixed whole-cell deadlines (timeout)

columns.rel_res: largest ||b-Ax||/||b|| over the retained repeats, on the original system
columns.setup_s: seconds, from the repeat with the median setup + solve
columns.cap_s: the competitor's time cap, when one applied
columns.class: grids, meshes (meshes and circuits), ipm (linear programs), social (social and web graphs)
